════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  TRAINING CONSOLE — FIELD GUIDE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  ┌─ CONTROL PLANE
  │  Ep / elapsed / ETA    Episode number · wall-clock time · estimated remaining
  │  ent / shp / ε         Entropy coef · shaping weight · ε-greedy rate
  │  [ENT-DECAY]           Entropy coefficient is being annealed down
  │  [cyc=Ax]              Soft cycling — only agent Ax updates its actor this interval
  │  [WARMUP]              Critic-only warmup phase (actor frozen)

  ┌─ MARKET TRAJECTORY  (one value per simulated year, oldest → newest)
  │  Price    Auction clearing price (€/t) · ↑/↓/→ = trend across episode years
  │  Emiss    Total fleet emissions (Mt/yr)
  │  Auct     Auction supply volume after MSR withholding/release (Mt)
  │  TNAC     Total Number of Allowances in Circulation at episode end (Mt)
  │  MSR      Shown only when cumulative cancellation > 0 — reserve & cancelled stock

  ┌─ HEALTH SNAPSHOT
  │  comply   % of (agent × year) pairs with zero shortfall (full compliance)
  │  green    Fleet-avg green energy fraction: start→end (Δpp = percentage-point change)
  │  sec      Secondary market: total volume · match rate · avg trade price
  │           ↓sell / ↑buy = mean sellers / buyers participating per year

  ┌─ PER-AGENT TABLE  (* = active cycling agent)
  │  Green      Green energy share: start→end %(Δpp)
  │  Emiss      Mean annual emissions (Mt)
  │  Alloc      Mean annual allowances received from auction (Mt)
  │  Sf         Shortfall-years / total-years (compliance failures); e.g. ' 3/12'
  │  yr1€       Bid price (€/t) in year 1 of the episode
  │  yrN€       Bid price (€/t) in the final year of the episode
  │  avg€       Quantity-weighted mean bid price across all episode years
  │  lo€        Lowest bid price across all episode years
  │  hi€        Highest bid price across all episode years
  │  BidMt      Mean annual bid quantity submitted to auction (Mt)
  │  Rew        Total reward summed over all years (raw RL signal)
  │  DiagPts    Sfin/Sgrn/Scomp shown as points on a 0–100 scale
  │               Sfin  = cost efficiency score       [0–100 pts]
  │               Sgrn  = green progress score        [0–100 pts]
  │               Scomp = weighted composite score    [0–100 pts]
  │  ALoss/CLoss  Actor / Critic loss from most recent PPO update
  │  Secondary    BNy/VMt@P€ = bought N years, V Mt at avg P €  │  HOLD = no trades

  ┌─ BOT TABLE  (heuristic agents — one row per bot)
  │  Same core columns as learning agents (single-price bids in current mode)
  │  Event board is printed as a separate section below the bot rows

  ┌─ EVENT BOARD  (separate visual block)
  │  Defaults by agent: A#/B#:<count>  (year-events where agent could not cover auction payment)
  │  Treasury/Loan: agents that drew treasury reserves or took emergency loans this episode
  │  Stuck states (learning agents): one line only if any condition occurs
  │  Format: ceiling=A#:<streak_ep> | floor=A#:<streak_ep> | zeroQty=A#:<streak_ep>
  │  Warnings (year-step counts) are printed here, not on the Health line
  │  Non-zero warning counters:
  │     lowAlloc    Allocation < 30% of auction volume (severe under-bidding)
  │     priceFloor  Clearing price hit the reserve floor (~30 €/t)
  │     priceCeil   Clearing price ≥ 90% of price_max (near hard cap)
  │     auctFail       Auction failed entirely (no valid bids or all below reserve)
  │     collateralClip Total bid rescales due to collateral budget limit (episode sum)
  │     lowDemand   Total bid demand < 70% of supply (weak market)
  │     noInvest    All agents chose invest_frac ≈ 0 (no green investment)
  │     debtSpiral  Agent had 3+ consecutive shortfall years (chronic non-compliance)
  │     bidCluster  Bid price std dev < €5 (all agents bidding nearly the same)
  │     overBank    TNAC > 2× total annual emissions (excessive allowance banking)
  │     1sideSec    All secondary-market participants on same side (no counterparty)
  │     noTrade     Zero secondary-market volume this year
  │     cornering   One agent holds disproportionate share of allocations (HHI risk)
  │     rsvReject   > 25% of bids fell below the reserve price (rejected)
